documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30Th June, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: For FY 2024-25, Pasupati Acrylon reported revenue from operations of Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh, representing an increase of 8.03% over the previous financial year. Profit after tax grew by 168.24% to Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh compared to Rs. 1,318.99 Lakh in FY 2023-24.

guidance.claim: Pasupati Acrylon expects sustained demand growth across all its segments.
guidance.quote: Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of its 150 KLPD grain-based Ethanol Project by September 2024.
guidance.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for acrylic fibers is expected to rise due to macroeconomic growth in end-use sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Sales of acrylic fibres are projected to grow driven by end-use sectors such as apparel, home furnishing, and industrial applications.
demand_outlook.quote: The rapid growth of end-use sectors including apparel, home furnishing, and industrial will therefore continue to propel the sales of acrylic fibres in the upcoming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for CPP Films is expected to expand owing to higher convenience food consumption and packaging needs.
demand_outlook.quote: The market for CPP Films is expected to increase in the near future due to the rise in the consumption of convenience foods and the high need for packaging solutions.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue and net profit declined due to lower acrylic fibre demand and falling CPP segment selling prices caused by market overcapacity.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to expand at a 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and started commercial production in March 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent around Rs. 188 Crore on the ethanol project, funded via Rs. 104 Crore term loan and the balance from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: A 750 KW Solar Power System has been installed by the company.
capex_expansion.quote: Solar Power System of 750 KW has been installed.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cost for the Ethanol Project is estimated at Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Indian Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 Crores for the Ethanol project, with Rs. 59.58 Crores funded through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent approximately Rs. 92.17 Crore on the Ethanol project so far.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 109.31% to Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh in FY 2024-25 from Rs. 2,684.93 Lakh in the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIDTA was Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh as against Rs. 2,684.93 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 109.31% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization measures through alternate sourcing and efficiency improvements led to significant savings.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Losses in the CPP segment declined due to better realization and reduced overheads.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the financial year decreased to Rs. 26.85 Crores from Rs. 58.20 Crores in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIDTA was Rs. 26.85 Crores as against Rs. 58.20 Crores in the previous financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Operating profit margin, net profit margin, and return on net worth declined due to higher production costs.
margins_costs.quote: Operating Profit Margin, Net Profit Margin and Return on Net Worth are declined as cost of production was relatively high as compared to previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's Acrylic products manufacturing plant has an installed capacity of 42,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 35,198 MT and sold 33,850 MT of Acrylic Fibre in FY 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's CPP film manufacturing plant has an installed capacity of 10,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During FY 2024-25, CPP film production stood at 6,343 MT and sales reached 6,409 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively as against production of 6,463 MT and sale of 6,476 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 31,534 MT and sold 31,685 MT of acrylic products during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT, as against production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Production and sales of CPP film reached 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively during FY 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively as against production of 7,663 MT and sale of 7,640 MT respectively during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board chose not to recommend any dividend for FY 2023-24 to conserve internal accruals for the Ethanol Plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided not to transfer any amount to reserves for the financial year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the Reserves for the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global acrylic fibre consumption is affected by price volatility in raw materials, energy, coal, and key inputs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations impact margins as the company depends on imports.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has no control over ethanol product prices as they are determined by Oil Marketing Companies.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, competition, and regulatory changes present key operational risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates and crude oil prices pose potential threats to profit margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Further, since the Company is dependent upon imported raw materials, movement in USD and increase in crude oil prices due to ongoing Israel-Hamas war and Russia-Ukraine war may affect the margin.

management_commitments.claim: The company is exploring options to increase its exports of Acrylic Fiber.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Peru, Thailand, Morrocco, Tunisia, Nepal, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Brazil, Poland, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: The company continuously explores opportunities to optimize and reduce energy costs.
management_commitments.quote: The company is continuously exploring various avenues to reduce and optimize energy cost.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to start commercial production at its 150 KLPD grain-based Ethanol Project by September 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.
